title: Valid PIN Login
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using a valid 4-digit PIN.

steps.description: Navigate to the login screen.
Enter a valid 4-digit PIN.
Click the login button.
Verify that the system authenticates the PIN and navigates to the Dashboard.

title: Invalid PIN Login
description: Verify system response when logging in with an invalid PIN (non-4-digit or incorrect PIN).

steps.description: Navigate to the login screen.
Enter an invalid PIN (e.g., less than or more than 4 digits or an incorrect 4-digit combination).
Click the login button.
Verify that the system rejects login and displays a user-friendly error message.

title: Master Code Reset Functionality
description: Verify that the administrative master code reset functionality works correctly.

steps.description: Access the master reset screen via admin controls.
Enter valid credentials or master key to authorize reset.
Perform PIN reset operation.
Verify that the PIN resets successfully and notifications confirm reset.

title: Member Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify complete lifecycle member registration with valid data including mandatory fields, unique member number, and uploads.

steps.description: Navigate to member registration page.
Fill in all required fields with valid data, ensuring member number is unique.
Upload valid photo and signature files.
Submit the member registration form.
Confirm member is created, visible in member list, and profile data is correct.

title: Member Registration with Missing Mandatory Fields
description: Verify appropriate error messages are shown when required profile fields are missing or empty.

steps.description: Navigate to member registration page.
Leave one or more mandatory fields empty.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
Verify that validation errors are displayed and the form is not submitted.

title: Member Number Uniqueness Enforcement
description: Validate that member number uniqueness is enforced on registration and edits.

steps.description: Attempt to register a new member with an existing member number.
Verify the system prevents duplicate member number registration with an error message.
Attempt to update an existing member to a member number already in use.
Verify the system rejects the update and displays an appropriate validation message.

title: Daily Transaction Entry Valid Data
description: Validate daily transaction entry with credit/debit operations, multiple account types, and transaction history update.

steps.description: Navigate to transaction entry page.
Select a valid member and account type (Savings, Loan, Shares, FD).
Enter a positive transaction amount and current or past date.
Submit the transaction.
Verify transaction appears in history and balances update accordingly.

title: Daily Transaction Entry with Invalid Amount and Date
description: Verify system prevents transaction with zero or negative amounts and future transaction dates.

steps.description: Navigate to transaction entry page.
Enter negative or zero transaction amount.
Attempt to submit transaction.
Verify error message disallows transaction submission.
Enter a future date for transaction.
Attempt submission again.
Verify error message indicates invalid future date and prevents submission.

title: Loan Interest Calculation Accuracy
description: Verify loan calculator correctly computes interest for various schemes, amounts, and durations.

steps.description: Navigate to Loan Calculator page.
Select different loan schemes and input varying principals and durations.
Calculate interest.
Verify calculated interest matches expected results based on scheme formula and rates.

title: Paddy Purchase Entry Valid Data
description: Verify entry of paddy purchase with correct member counts, bag types, weights, and storage allocation including cumulative storage update.

steps.description: Navigate to Paddy Purchase page.
Input tribal and non-tribal member counts.
Enter quantities for new, old, and used once bags.
Specify weights and select storage location (godown, shed, open).
Submit purchase entry.
Verify storage allocation is updated cumulatively and purchase details appear correctly.

title: Meeting Record and Notice Generation
description: Verify recording society meetings with required data, attendee tracking, Marathi notice generation, and printing/sharing functionality.

steps.description: Navigate to Meetings page.
Create a new meeting record with mandatory fields and meeting type (AGM, monthly, emergency, committee).
Add attendees and resolutions.
Generate meeting notice in Marathi.
Print or share the meeting notice.
Verify meeting data is saved, attendee list is recorded, notices are properly formatted in Marathi, and print/share actions work as intended.

title: Report Generation and Export with Marathi Unicode Support
description: Validate various reports generate correctly and export in CSV and PDF formats with Marathi language characters properly rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to Reports page.
Select different report types including loan reports, NPA summary, bank incentives, member statements.
Apply filters and generate reports.
Export reports in CSV and PDF formats with filenames containing Marathi characters.
Ensure report data is accurate, exports succeed, Marathi text renders correctly, and filenames preserve Unicode characters.

title: Expense Entry with Receipt Upload
description: Verify user can enter expenses with categories, upload receipts, and view expense reporting.

steps.description: Navigate to Expenses page.
Enter expense details including category and amount.
Upload a valid receipt image or document.
Submit expense entry.
Verify expense is listed with receipt preview available and category filtering works.

title: Bank Audit Note Management
description: Validate functionality for adding, editing, and tracking audit notes and bank balances across multiple accounts.

steps.description: Navigate to Bank Audit page.
Add a new bank account with opening balance.
Insert audit notes related to transactions.
Edit existing bank accounts and audit entries.
Verify bank accounts and notes appear correctly, balances update properly, and audit entries are editable and searchable.

title: AI Chat Assistant Interaction
description: Verify the AI chat assistant activates, accepts user queries, and provides relevant responses to guide users through app features.

steps.description: Open the AI Chat Assistant widget.
Enter common queries about member registration, transaction entry, and report generation.
Verify that the AI assistant responds with coherent, relevant, and helpful guidance.

title: Google Drive Backup and Restore
description: Verify data backup and restore functionality using Google Drive integration performs reliably without data loss.

steps.description: Navigate to settings and initiate a backup to Google Drive.
Confirm backup completes successfully and file is created on Google Drive.
Delete or alter some data in the app.
Perform a restore operation from the Google Drive backup.
Verify that data is restored fully and matches backup state exactly.

title: Responsive UI and Dark Mode Toggle
description: Verify that the application UI adapts correctly to different screen sizes and toggling dark mode changes UI theme consistently.

steps.description: Resize the browser window to various dimensions including mobile widths.
Verify sidebar navigation and content layout adjusts responsively.
Toggle Dark Mode from settings or UI controls.
Verify the UI theme switches to dark colors across all pages and components consistently.

title: Transaction Filtering and Export
description: Verify that users can filter transactions by date, member, and account type and export filtered data correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to Transactions page.
Apply filters by date range, specific member, and account type.
Verify displayed transactions match filter criteria.
Export filtered transactions to CSV and PDF.
Verify exported files contain only filtered data with correct formatting.

title: Security PIN Modal for Sensitive Operations
description: Verify that sensitive operations prompt for security PIN modal and block unauthorized access if PIN is incorrect.

steps.description: Attempt a sensitive operation such as changing financial year configuration or deleting member data.
Verify security PIN modal prompts for PIN entry.
Enter incorrect PIN.
Verify operation is blocked with error message.
Enter correct PIN.
Verify operation proceeds successfully.

title: Data Persistence and Synchronization with Firebase
description: Verify that data is correctly saved to Firebase Firestore and synced in real-time across devices.

steps.description: Perform data changes such as member addition or transaction entry on one device.
Simultaneously access the application from another device or browser session.
Verify changes reflect without refresh or delay due to real-time sync.
